name: Ieiri Sou
source:
A hacker who has broken through the security systems of many large corporations using his student status as a cover.
One day, he was noticed and arrested by the Public Security Police. He decided to cooperate with them on their investigations on the condition that he would be released.
He strongly dislikes androids and will not eat any food that are prepared by them.
